dishes.name: Summer Berry Morning Porridge
dishes.title: Oats with whole milk and fresh berries
dishes.method: Simmer the oats and milk in a small pan until creamy, then top with the fresh berries.
dishes.why: A warm, small breakfast as the coach recommends for those who aren't early eaters.

dishes.name: Golden Seed Butter Toast
dishes.title: Toasted bread with sunflower seed butter
dishes.method: Toast the bread and spread generously with the sunflower seed butter.
dishes.why: I have swapped the requested pistachio butter for sunflower seed butter to protect against the medical allergy constraint.

dishes.name: Honey and Seed Yogurt Bowl
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with honey and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl, drizzle with honey and scatter the seeds on top.
dishes.why: A fresh, protein-rich start that avoids fennel as requested.

dishes.name: Summer Green Bean Chicken
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken thighs with new potatoes and green beans
dishes.method: Warm the contents of the box in a wide pan over a medium heat with a splash of water until steaming.
dishes.why: The green beans are the loud vegetable here, providing a fresh crunch to the plate.

dishes.name: Power Chicken and Potato Pan
dishes.title: Large portion of seared chicken and potatoes with green beans
dishes.method: Reheat the larger portion in a pan until the chicken is hot through and the potatoes are sizzling.
dishes.why: A larger share of protein and starch to support muscle gain goals.

dishes.name: Vibrant Green Chicken Plate
dishes.title: Chicken thighs with extra green beans and light potatoes
dishes.method: Pan-heat the portion until hot, ensuring the green beans stay bright and crisp.
dishes.why: Generous vegetables and full protein with a lighter starch share as requested.

dishes.name: Crimson Pepper Beef Stir-fry
dishes.title: Beef and bell pepper stir-fry with steamed rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef and peppers in a hot pan; warm the rice separately with a teaspoon of water.
dishes.why: A warm dinner featuring loud bell peppers to ensure you don't leave the table hungry.

dishes.name: Starch-Fuelled Beef Stir-fry
dishes.title: Large beef and pepper stir-fry with extra rice
dishes.method: Heat the beef and the large rice portion in a pan until piping hot.
dishes.why: Starch follows the session: a larger rice portion here fuels your muscle gain stretch.

dishes.name: Garden Pepper Beef Bowl
dishes.title: Beef stir-fry with extra peppers and light rice
dishes.method: Warm the beef and pepper mix thoroughly, serving with the smaller rice portion.
dishes.why: Focused on generous vegetables and full protein while keeping the starch share lower.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Chicken and New Potatoes
preparations.method: Halve the potatoes and boil in salted water until tender (15 mins). Meanwhile, season and pan-sear the chicken thighs in oil until golden and cooked through. Steam the green beans over the potatoes for the last 4 minutes. Drain and toss everything together.

preparations.title: Beef and Bell Pepper Stir-fry
preparations.method: Slice peppers and onions. Heat oil in a large pan or wok. Sear the beef strips quickly on high heat until browned, then remove. Toss in the peppers and onions, stir-fry for 5 minutes, then return the beef to the pan to combine.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice and boil in a pot with double the volume of water. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes, then let stand for 5 minutes before fluffing.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the potatoes boiling. While they cook, get the rice on another ring. Sear the chicken thighs in a large pan. Once the chicken is done, use that pan for the beef and pepper stir-fry. Steam the green beans over the potatoes for the final few minutes. Box all portions according to the gram weights.

member_portions.portion_note: A larger share of chicken and potatoes for lunch, and a generous rice portion with the beef for dinner.
Child-size portions of the shared chicken and beef dishes.
Full protein share with extra vegetables and a smaller starch share; no fennel.

preparation_shares.note: Generous green beans, full chicken share, few potatoes.
